plan_rows.note_en: Implements option B of owner answer QL9 (2026-09-11). Measured basis at HEAD: `packages/shared/src/plugins/source-resolver.ts` refuses every host with one line — github.com, or any hostname containing the substring `gitlab` — and `SUPPORTED_REPOSITORY_HOSTS` in the same file is the sentence the user reads, naming `archive` and `npm` as the alternatives. Done means our own git host installs, a control host still refuses with the named alternatives, and the substring test is replaced by something a hostname cannot pass by accident. Re-stamps L13 Pi/Claude/Codex from `partial ᵗ` to `covered ᵗ` when it lands.
